name: MBE World Heavyweight Championship
notes: MBE's own top championship, defended and retained through every fwrestling.com-era show read this pass.
epitaph: MBE's own big gold belt, held through the whole of its fwrestling.com relaunch without once changing hands on the shows this pass could read.

name: MBE World Tag Team Championship
notes: MBE's own tag title, successfully defended in a ladder match on the first show of the fwrestling.com relaunch.
epitaph: MBE's own tag straps, kept by the Thrillbillies through a ladder match against a trio of their own hooligan rivals.
